newsitem.title: INDIA: India's L&T, Komatsu plan jv.
newsitem.headline: India's L&T, Komatsu plan jv.

text.p: Indian engineering and construction firm Larsen & Toubro Ltd (L&T) said on Wednesday it is in talks with Komatsu Ltd whereby L&T will spin off its earthmoving equipment business into a joint venture with the Japanese firm.
"Our talks with Komatsu are continuing," a company spokesman told Reuters.

He denied a local newspaper report which said term-lending bank Industrial Development Bank of India (IDBI), an institutional shareholder of L&T, had objected to the proposal to spin off L&T earthmoving equipment division into a new firm.
"IDBI has not come back to us," the spokesman said.

The Business Standard on Wednesday said the sale of the division to the joint venture would be done in 1997 but the valuation of the business was done on the basis of its performance in 1995. IDBI had objected to this, it said.
